name: The Olive Oil Factory Store
old_description: Artisans of superior quality olive oils, vinegars and delicious foods
about:
The Olive Oil Factory Store operates a family-owned and operated tasting room in Waterbury, Connecticut. The business sells gourmet olive oils, vinegars, and specialty foods both in-store and online through its Delavignes brand.

The store offers a rotating selection of extra virgin olive oils, balsamic and golden balsamic vinegars, gift baskets, and pantry items such as cheesemaking kits, baking extracts, and heirloom popcorn. Every Friday the kitchen produces traditional focaccia breads and sourdough baguettes for immediate sale. The retail space is open Monday through Friday 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. and Saturday 10 a.m. to 3 p.m., with free samples available for visitors.

The company sources local artisan cheeses and charcuterie from producers in Litchfield and New Haven Counties, and carries imported products such as Spanish organic extra virgin olive oil and authentic Prosciutto di Parma. Customers include walk-in shoppers, online gift buyers, and corporate gift programs seeking curated food assortments.

The business emphasizes its artisan approach to superior quality olive oils, vinegars, and delicious foods, differentiating itself through a physical tasting room experience, weekly fresh baking, and a focus on locally sourced Connecticut products alongside its own Delavignes label.
